meta: Make Vietnamese-English subtitles with AI for short videos, because so many people watch with the sound off.

muc.title: Watching on mute
muc.text: So many people watch videos with the sound off that a video without subtitles misses a lot of viewers.

muc.title: Two lines max
muc.text: Mark học AI splits the voiceover into short chunks, each at most two lines on a vertical screen.

muc.title: Accurate but natural
muc.text: Paste each chunk into a chatbot, an AI chat assistant, and ask for short English sentences that keep the key terms.

muc.title: Reread every line
muc.text: AI can still mistranslate meanings or names, so always reread, especially numbers and terms.

muc.title: Subtitles in two languages
muc.text: Paste a short video's script into a chatbot and ask it to split it into subtitle chunks with English underneath.
